name: Techo International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 4,000 m long and 75 m wide including shoulders (Phase 1)
runway.quote: one runway measuring 4,000 meters in length and 75 meters in width including shoulder

max_aircraft.v: aerodrome category 4F (takes the largest airliners, code F)
max_aircraft.quote: TIA is a 4F category greenfield airport covering 2,600 hectares

handling.v: private and business aircraft go through the airport's Business Aviation department; VIP terminals open 24 hours, 7 days, with ground handling and visa and immigration services; eight accredited business-aviation partners listed (Asia Flight Services / Indochina Aviation Centre, AANC Aviation Alliance Network (Cambodia), CA Aviation, EJET Services, FBO & Aviation Services (Cambodia), Khmer Aero Technical Services, Memory Aviation, Royal Group Services Cambodia). No notice period stated
handling.quote: Cambodia Airports’ Business Aviation department is the entry point for all private/business aircrafts ... Our VIP Terminals, at the 2 airports, operate around the clock (24h/24, 7/7)

missing: runway designation and paved width (AD 2 VDTI)
